about: Reference values for VBS (GuestStateIsolationType 1) paravisor images on nucbox-k11, for the custom-VM verifier (enclave-99, docs/security/nucbox-custom-vm-verifier.md check V4). Every value is derived from the pinned bytes and re-checked by windows/vbslike/pkg/pkg.mjs verify on every run; do not edit by hand.
rule: Refuse by EXACT vbsBootDigest only. Never use debugBuild to exclude an image: it follows the manifest's enable_debug and is false for --confidential-debug images too. confidentialDebug is read from the image bytes (OPENHCL_CONFIDENTIAL_DEBUG=1 in the measured command line); such an image trusts the host command line.
eligible: true only for the non-debug measured-VTL0 candidate, and only once the paravisor report format is registered and report bytes are pinned (enclave-99). Not an allowlist today. A report-level debug indication, if the report has one, is an extra refusal, never a substitute (enclave-99).
notAClaim: No image here is an isolation claim; host_excluded=no.

images.vtl0: linux, MEASURED: our kernel (vmlinux 363b3553), the G1+G3 initrd 680d40fa and command line as measured pages; static_command_line=true (the paravisor line is exactly the measured bytes)
images.booted: yes: BOOTED and SERVED as a type-1 partition under Secure Boot, and its per-boot nonce HOLDS (enclave-d1, canary 070020, 2026-09-25 07:00:44-07:01:24Z, evidence 7b509d16, script uefi-dev-boot.ps1 at 95752533): MON ready with hv_isolation=vbs paravisor=no host_excluded=no and 'MON boot 39725c19e15c91afe488ce62251055f5'; hello-world loaded with hash agreement under that boot and served its 13 pinned bytes through the guest's own TLS; a destroy without boot was refused (bootRequired) and one with a wrong boot answered rebooted:true, both touching nothing (app still 200); the load answer's own boot destroyed the domain. Not covered: the launcher's own rebooted:true handling, and G4. No report was requested; identity, any report or chain, and host exclusion are NOT established.
images.reason: the ONLY image eligible for an allowlist (since v31), and only once the paravisor report format is registered and report bytes from this image verify under the same boot's IDKS (enclave-99): eligibility stays PROSPECTIVE. It has booted and served a pinned app (type 1, Secure Boot), with the G1 nonce holding; no report exists.
